title: Proposal: DAO Financial Strategist Team
body:
## Proposal: DAO Financial Strategist Team

**Date: 1st June 2022**
**Authors: Advait Rane, Vismay Joshi**



**About this proposal:**

This proposal is regarding our willingness to continue contributing to the Edgeware Ecosystem as the DFS (DAO Financial Strategist Team) consisting of Advait and Vismay. The two of us started contributing to the Edgeware Ecosystem back in September’21 as a part of the Edgeware Agency and have been actively involved in various activities in the Edgeverse since then. We also have been actively presenting our contributions to the community in the Weekly Financial Call held every week. Below is a list of deliverables, some of which are ongoing and others are planned for delivery as a part of this proposal.
The validity of this proposal will be for 4 months(June, July, August, September), after which we want to revisit and modify our deliverables (if required) based on the community feedback.


**Ongoing/Planned Contributions:**

**1. EDG DAO Financial Bulletin (ongoing)**
	

**2. Research and suggestions on network parameter enhancements (planned)**

This deliverable will consist of quantitative research and analysis activities related to the optimisation of network parameters like the inflation model, treasury proposal parameters, treasury tip parameters etc. 
We have already delivered a similar research and analysis task related to the optimisation of the bounty parameters(linked below).


**3. Proposal benchmarking (planned)**
	
The Edgeware DAO receives a lot of proposals which are related to various fields like finance, arts, social good etc. and there is definitely a need to do a proper official benchmarking of these proposals, wrt the amount requested for the deliverables promised.
Thus, we would like to carry out this role, where we benchmark the upcoming proposals based on the amount asked and the usefulness of the contribution to the community.
